title: Intrinsic Self-Correction in LLMs: Towards Explainable Prompting via Mechanistic Interpretability
reasoning: The paper explores the mechanistic drivers of 'intrinsic self-correction' in LLMs, specifically using text detoxification as a primary testbed. It explicitly references 'intrinsic moral self-correction' and evaluates how models steer their representations to avoid 'toxic, offensive, and harmful' content, which falls under moral and ethical alignment.
